title: Human Kidney/Tumour Tissue Disaggregation for Single Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Kevin Loudon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qtrdwm6

steps.title: Weigh dissected tissue
steps.instruction: Take the dissected renal cortex, medulla or tumour tissue and weigh 0.5–1 g (typical biopsy size).

steps.title: Prepare Digest Mix
steps.instruction: For 50 mL RPMI add 625 µL Liberase TM (stock 2.5 mg/mL) and 250 µL DNAse (stock 0.05 mg/mL); mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Mince tissue and add digest
steps.instruction: Using a sterile razor blade, mince the tissue into ~2 mm pieces, place in a 10 cm dish and pour 2–3 mL of the prepared Digest Mix over the pieces.

steps.title: Transfer to gentleMACS tube
steps.instruction: Move the minced tissue into a gentleMACS C tube (Miltenyi Biotec, Cat. 130‑096‑334) and add an additional 3–4 mL Digest Mix.

steps.title: Incubate with shaking
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a shaking incubator set to 37 °C and incubate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Run the gentleMACS dissociator on the tube using program “Spleen 4” followed by “Lung 2”.

steps.title: Filter and wash cells
steps.instruction: Pass the dissociated suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer using a 2.5 mL syringe plunger; immediately wash the retained material with cold running buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare running buffer (per 1 L): 1 L PBS, 5 mL BSA (from reagent diluent kit), 4 mL 0.5 M EDTA.
Collect the filtrate for the next step.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 2000 RPM for 10 minutes in a bench‑top centrifuge; carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Optional red‑cell lysis
steps.instruction: If the pellet appears contaminated with red blood cells, perform an additional red‑cell lysis step (protocol not detailed here).

steps.title: Live‑cell enrichment
steps.instruction: Enrich viable cells using Miltenyi Dead Cell Removal Kit (Cat. 130‑090‑101) and an appropriate MACS column (LS for ≤10⁸ dead cells or ≤10⁹ total cells).

substeps.instruction: Remove all supernatant from the previous centrifugation.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL Dead Cell Removal MicroBeads per ~10⁷ total cells.
Rinse the MACS column with 1× binding buffer as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Apply the cell suspension diluted in 1–10 mL binding buffer onto the column; collect the flow‑through (negative fraction) which contains live cells.
Wash the collected live cells with PBS for 5 minutes at 1500 RPM.

steps.title: Count and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Count the live cells and resuspend them in the volume of PBS required for the 10X Genomics single‑cell application.
